# Environment

```{r}
# Packages
packages <- c("tidyverse", "ComplexHeatmap", "ggtext", "cowplot", "grid",'toml') 
# Load packages
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE))

# Print environment
set.seed(45)
Sys.info()
sessionInfo() 
```

# Load data
```{r}
files_of_interest <- list.files("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/database/gene_references/",pattern = ".fasta$") %>% gsub("\\.fasta","",.)
```

# Config file edit
```{r}
model_config <- readLines("~/Desktop/gl_scratch_kg/Project_NG_surveillance/Analysis/2025_NG_pipeline_testing/NG_probe_capture_ms/data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/CoverageStats/config/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_model.yaml")

lapply(files_of_interest,FUN=function(x){
  cat(x)
  edited_config <- model_config
  edited_config <- edited_config %>% gsub("model",x,.)
  writeLines(text = edited_config,con = paste0("~/Desktop/gl_scratch_kg/Project_NG_surveillance/Analysis/2025_NG_pipeline_testing/NG_probe_capture_ms/data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/CoverageStats/config/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_",x,".yaml"))
})
```


# Sbat file edit
```{r}
model_sbat <- readLines("~/Desktop/gl_scratch_kg/Project_NG_surveillance/Analysis/2025_NG_pipeline_testing/NG_probe_capture_ms/data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/CoverageStats/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_model.sbat")

lapply(files_of_interest,FUN=function(x){
  cat(x)
  edited_sbat <- model_sbat
  edited_sbat <- edited_sbat %>% gsub("model",x,.)
  writeLines(text = edited_sbat,con = paste0("~/Desktop/gl_scratch_kg/Project_NG_surveillance/Analysis/2025_NG_pipeline_testing/NG_probe_capture_ms/data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/CoverageStats/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_",x,".sbat"))
})
```

# Run sbat script
```{r}
sbat_functions <- lapply(files_of_interest,FUN=function(x){
  paste0("sbatch CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_",x,".sbat")
}) %>% unlist

commands <- c("#!/bin/sh",sbat_functions)

writeLines(commands,"~/Desktop/gl_scratch_kg/Project_NG_surveillance/Analysis/2025_NG_pipeline_testing/NG_probe_capture_ms/data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/CoverageStats/run_Coverage_stats_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_jobs.sh")
```
